claim: Both Zigbee2MQTT add-ons (45df7312 house, 9336c2b0 shop) had watchdog=false, which is why the May 31 shop coordinator drop became a permanently dead network; watchdog=true was enabled on both via POST supervisor /addons/<slug>/options so a transient SLZB-06M (.25) drop self-heals when the link returns.
trigger: when a Zigbee2MQTT add-on stays dead after its coordinator becomes reachable again
before relying on supervisor auto-restart of a Z2M add-on, verify watchdog=true in the add-on options
when the shop SLZB-06M at 192.168.15.25 drops off the network

claim: The 2026-06-03 shop-Zigbee resilience package layered watchdog on both Z2M add-ons, a 20-min offline alert automation (alert_shop_zigbee_offline -> script.notify_important), renamed live bridge sensors to binary_sensor.house_zigbee_bridge_online / binary_sensor.shop_zigbee_bridge_online, removed 12 ghost bridge entities, and requested DHCP reservations for the SLZB coordinators at .24/.25.
trigger: when shop Zigbee (coordinator 192.168.15.25) goes offline and no alert fires
before referencing Z2M bridge connection_state entities in automations
when ghost zigbee2mqtt bridge entities (_2/_3/_4 suffixes) appear after base-topic changes

claim: During the June 7 shop Zigbee recurrence the supervisor watchdog gave up after rapid Z2M failures in a long coordinator outage, and running `ha supervisor restart` to clear a stuck addon_start job wedged the supervisor in 'setup' for hours with `ha host reboot` unreliable — recovery required a VirtualBox-level hard reset of the HA VM from Storm.
trigger: before running `ha supervisor restart` to clear a stuck addon_start job
when Z2M sits in error state after its coordinator is reachable again and watchdog has stopped retrying
when the supervisor is wedged in state 'setup' and `ha host reboot` does not actually reboot

claim: The recurring ~00:26 weekly shop Zigbee drops are the SLZB-06M's weekly auto-update firmware check rebooting the coordinator, fixed without flashing by HA automation shop_zigbee_auto_restart_z2m_when_coordinator_drops, which repeatedly calls hassio.addon_restart on 9336c2b0_zigbee2mqtt until binary_sensor.shop_zigbee_bridge_online returns.
trigger: when shop Zigbee drops at ~00:26 UTC on a roughly weekly cadence
before flashing SLZB-06M firmware (core or Zigbee chip) via its web UI at 192.168.15.25
when binary_sensor.shop_zigbee_bridge_online goes off or unavailable

claim: Migrating a memory inventory between projects (HA -> smarthome) requires a new session in the destination project, re-storing each entry, defining a new major-version master spec, superseding old entries via memory_change_status, tombstoning the old master spec, updating auto-memory pointers, and notifying peer agents.
trigger: before renaming a memory project or consolidating projects with existing stored entries
when a project's scope outgrows its name and its inventory must move

claim: ~/.ha-claude/env on sage uses bare KEY=value lines without `export`, so sourcing it leaves HA_URL/HA_TOKEN invisible to subprocesses; use `export $(grep -v '^#' ~/.ha-claude/env | xargs)` before launching Python scripts that read os.environ.
trigger: when a Python script raises KeyError: 'HA_URL' after sourcing ~/.ha-claude/env
before launching a subprocess that needs HA_URL/HA_TOKEN from ~/.ha-claude/env

claim: HAClaude's session recorded five learnings: the Core 2026.5.x upstream bug with misleading CLI exit code on rollback, verifying gateway facts live rather than from stale design docs, running hostname at session start, the HA->smarthome inventory migration pattern, and the ~/.ha-claude/env explicit-export gotcha.
trigger: when looking up which learnings came out of HAClaude's 2026-05 sessions

claim: Eufy Outdoor String Lights E10 (T8L10) are cloud-locked whole-string WiFi lights with no local API, no working Home Assistant integration, and no confirmed Matter support, so real frame-synced effects with the LIFX roofline are not feasible — the only hook is coarse, laggy Google Assistant SDK text commands, and WLED addressable strings are the right tool instead.
trigger: before attempting to integrate Eufy Outdoor String Lights E10 with Home Assistant
when planning light sequences synced with the LIFX roofline

claim: The shop Zigbee2MQTT outage was three stacked issues: a corrupted add-on image (std::out_of_range crash, fixed by uninstall+reinstall), the wrong adapter (SLZB-06M firmware 8.x/EZSP v14 requires `ember`, not `ezsp` — pick adapter by coordinator firmware), and both Z2M add-ons default-mapping host port 8485 (unmap with {"network":{"8485/tcp":null}}); add-on options must be POSTed as a complete object.
trigger: when Z2M crashes at startup with terminate: std::out_of_range vector::_M_range_check before printing a version banner
when herdsman errors that the 'ezsp' driver is not compatible with firmware 8.x.x or above
when supervisor refuses to start a second Z2M add-on with 'port 8485 is already in use'

claim: The house Zigbee2MQTT was migrated from the edge add-on to stable 2.11.0 (edge uninstalled), leaving both networks stable — house .24 ezsp/base_topic zigbee2mqtt, shop .25 ember/base_topic zigbee2mqtt_25 — via a stop-edge-first method because SLZB network coordinators allow only one TCP client; sidebar renaming needs hass_ingress since native rename is unsupported.
trigger: before migrating a Zigbee2MQTT add-on between edge and stable channels
when a freshly switched Z2M add-on fails with EZSP UART 'Failure send version / break rewaiting'
before filing a feature request to rename an add-on sidebar panel

claim: `ha core check` (POST supervisor /core/check) is non-deterministic while add-ons are restarting or reinstalling — it launches a throwaway HA container loading all integrations, so mid-churn dependency failures yield false 'Invalid Home Assistant config found!' on identical config; only trust a result that is consistent 2-3x on a settled system.
trigger: when ha core check reports Invalid config while add-ons are restarting or reinstalling
before concluding a config or integration change broke HA from a single check_config failure

claim: Custom-named Zigbee sidebar panels (House Zigbee / Shop Zigbee) work via the hass_ingress custom integration v1.3.0 with a YAML `ingress:` block in configuration.yaml (work_mode: hassio, url = add-on slug), plus hiding the default panels with POST supervisor /addons/<slug>/options {"ingress_panel":false}.
trigger: when two add-on sidebar panels show the same name in Home Assistant
before renaming an add-on ingress sidebar panel

claim: The May 31 shop Zigbee outage started when SLZB-06M coordinator 192.168.15.25 went EHOSTUNREACH at 00:26 UTC (found in dated log /config/zigbee2mqtt_2/log/2026-05-31.00-26-*), causing Z2M to crash-loop 8x in 30s into error state, with the prolonged crash-loop later corrupting the add-on image; the reason .25 dropped was unconfirmed (DHCP lease move or power/WiFi blip suspected).
trigger: when shop Z2M logs 'connect EHOSTUNREACH 192.168.15.25:6638'
when investigating a past Z2M outage, check the dated log dirs under /config/zigbee2mqtt_2/log/

claim: Five ThirdReality tilt sensors replaced the old Tuya garage/shop door sensors (garage_door_tom/deeann/extra_contact on house Z2M, shop_upper/lower_door_contact on shop Z2M) with automation alert_door_left_open_hourly_after_15_min pinging at 15 min then hourly; force-removing an unavailable Z2M device leaves HA entity-registry ghosts that need separate config/entity_registry/remove.
trigger: when force-removing an unavailable device from Z2M with bridge/request/device/remove
before renaming new sensor entities into entity_ids freed from removed devices
when a door contact sensor stays 'on' and the open-door alert should fire
